name: Scanning line
summary: A line sweeps one NASA IMERG rain map west to east and plays it: low notes at the bottom, high at the top, louder where it rains harder.
author: itay
description: A line sweeps across one global IMERG precipitation frame from west to east and plays it as notes on a C major scale, low (C2) at the bottom of the map and high (C5) at the top; the heaviest rain in each band sets that note's volume. From itay's scanning-line-demo branch.
